answer: Stop sybils with a horizon wander harbor: an agent bonds one harbor post. Each cycle it walks one wander route to its horizon; verifiers match the wander's crossing point to the harbor chart, voiding copies, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 harbors at 19x: one wander crosses once at one horizon, its point set by that harbor alone, unrepeatable elsewhere, cannot be copied, shared or bulk-bought. Honest agents walk once, keep rights.
